title: Organizations named in the Digital Transformation Handbooks
description: Organizations that several handbooks (dth-pc, dth-sc, dth-hrh, dth-phc, dth-sfp) name, held once here as SKOS concepts with a foaf:focus to a W3C ORG organization (owner, 2026-10-31, option B; litlfred/folio-assistant-core#411). The concept carries the name and the acronym (notation); the organization carries its ORG type, homepage and parent. A handbook lists these under members and never copies them. An organization only one handbook names, such as a national regulator, stays in that handbook's glossary. Every term is a candidate: only a person adopts a definition.
